scripts.install:dependencies: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix apps/desktop ci --ignore-scripts && npm run lint:dependencies && npm run lint:release-age && npm run audit:signatures && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run rebuild:dependencies
scripts.rebuild:dependencies: npm rebuild --ignore-scripts=false && npm --prefix apps/desktop rebuild --ignore-scripts=false && npm --prefix apps/desktop run install:electron
scripts.audit:signatures: npm audit signatures && npm --prefix apps/desktop audit signatures
scripts.lint: npm run lint:dependencies && npm run lint:lockfile && npm --prefix apps/desktop run lint
scripts.lint:lockfile: eslint --config eslint.lockfile.config.mjs package-lock.json apps/desktop/package-lock.json package.json apps/*/package.json && npm run lint:release-age
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/desktop test && npm run --workspace streamfusion-worker test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck && npm run --workspace streamfusion-worker typecheck
